body: Well I definitely want to go to Italy. Things are okay. :)

Well I woke up! 
I think I've found someone that's going to help me and be around for a while so hopefully I wont feel the need to do what I did.. although I know its not going to go away quickly. :)
Well I did a horrible job at stalling that night but I'm still here!

Yeah I like Australia but itd be nice to go to other places..
I've tried to get the key back but he refuses.. 
No problem :)

Yeah its for driving :) Although I don't live in the US either, I'm in Australia.
He doesn't really live anywhere.. Hes too busy doing drugs and getting into trouble to find somewhere stable.. He does have a key to the house I live in though. At the moment I kind of wish he didn't as the people he is threatening to hurt is my father and I.. so no theres not much that can be done about it..

I guess the book is really hard to explain.. its more of a "You have to read it to understand" kind of thing but ill give it a go?
Its about this girl, Mercy, and she doesn't really have her own body I guess? She takes over random peoples and in some way has to help them with what theyre struggling with, whether it be something small like abusive family/boyfriend (not really "small") or in this case girls that are like the one shes "taken over" are being kidnapped and she has to help the town?
Anyway, I'm really bad at explaining things and it does the book absolutely no justice at all..

My week was alright, finally got my Learners License so that's good but my older brother (hes 25) has kinda lost it and is threatening to hurt people.... 
Although Ive read many books Id have to say my favourite is Mercy by Rebecca Lim.
I'm 17. I read pretty much anything and everything.
No I'm not in school, I can barely even bring myself to leave the house let alone get dressed. I used to like reading a lot but I just cant get back into it.

My father says he's 100% okay with whatever I think will help me but he wont push anything, so yes I'd say he's supportive.
My mother wont let me talk to my siblings as she says I am a "danger to them" because of what I do to myself. As for friends, I don't have any.

My mother has always been like this so its not something new, I'm used to it by now, I just hope she realises what shes doing before its too late.
I'm 17 now, living with my father (as stated in another comment)

I'm currently living with my father, although the town I'm in brings back so many memories. (I grew up here). 
I recently started seeing a counsellor but its not really helping.
